interface.name: knave_workspace_capture_manager_v1
interface.description: A private Villain extension for trusted desktop clients. Sources capture only windows in the active allowed workspace, excluding shell layers and overview panes. When the active workspace is excluded, a source retains its last allowed frame; until one exists it produces opaque black. The mask is immutable for the source lifetime. No excluded workspace may be rendered or copied into the source. Standard ext-image-copy-capture sessions own frame delivery and cancellation. Clients must obtain consent before starting a stream. This protocol does not grant input access.

arg.name: count
arg.summary: supported fixed workspace count, at most 32
